description: Search Walmart.com product listings by keyword. HTTP-only via curl_cffi with chrome131 impersonation.

brandContains.description: Only emit products whose brand contains this substring.
brandContains.title: Brand contains (case-insensitive)

excludeSponsored.description: Drop sponsored / promoted product placements (keep only organic results).
excludeSponsored.title: Exclude sponsored

freeShippingOnly.description: Only emit products marked as free-shipping eligible.
freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted product records.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Maximum search-result pages to walk (~24 products per page).
maxPages.title: Max pages

minRating.description: Drop products with average rating below this (0.0-5.0). Products without a rating are kept.
minRating.title: Min rating

minReviewCount.description: Drop products with fewer reviews than this.
minReviewCount.title: Min review count

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword to search for on walmart.com. e.g. `iphone case`, `coffee maker`, `running shoes`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sellerContains.description: Only emit products whose seller name contains this substring (case-insensitive).
sellerContains.title: Seller name contains

useApifyProxy.description: Route requests through Apify proxy. Walmart works fine without proxy from datacenter IPs, but enabling helps with very long runs (1000+ products).
useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify proxy

title: Walmart Search Scraper Input
